h1: Tiamo Kohlarn — a brand-new hotel with a pool near Tawaen Beach on Koh Larn
intro: On an island where most stays are older guesthouses, finding a small hotel with fresh rooms and a swimming pool is rare — Tiamo Kohlarn is a 3-star boutique hotel that opened in 2024 near Tawaen Beach. Rooms are new and clean, there's an outdoor pool to cool off in, it's about a 10-minute walk from Na Ban Pier and roughly 1 km from Tawaen Beach. It scores 8.7 from 45 Trip.com reviews, from approx. ฿2,200/night.

body.html: What makes Tiamo Kohlarn stand out on Koh Larn is simply how new it is. The hotel opened in 2024 and was renovated again in 2025, so the rooms still feel fresh and clean, without the worn furniture you find in many of the island's older guesthouses. It's a small property of around 14 rooms with a quiet, private feel, and crucially it has an outdoor swimming pool — something only a handful of stays at this price offer on Koh Larn.

There's a decent spread of room types: Superior Queen, Superior Sea View, Studio, and a Family Room for groups or families. Every room is air-conditioned with a private bathroom, hairdryer, TV and free Wi-Fi. The rooms are bright and clean, and several reviewers note the rooms feel newer and tidier than expected for the price on the island. The Superior Sea View gives a more open outlook than the garden-side rooms if you want an airier feel.
"Super clean new rooms, lovely friendly staff, a pool to cool off in, tasty breakfast, and not a long walk from the pier — great value for a stay on the island."

Real guest reviews line up on two points: staff and breakfast. Many praise the team as warm and genuinely helpful — arranging transport, booking tours, and pointing out where to go. Breakfast is American-style, served 08:00–10:00, and is described as tasty and generous, though a few note the choice isn't huge. The hotel has its own restaurant, free parking, and sits within walking reach of local shops and eateries.

One thing to know before booking: Tiamo is not a step-onto-the-sand beachfront stay. It sits about 1 km from Tawaen Beach, so you'll walk, rent a scooter, or grab a ride to reach the water. Being a new hotel, some guests mention that a few facilities are still being improved, and breakfast may carry an extra charge on top of the room rate in some packages — check whether breakfast is included when you book.

Honestly, Tiamo Kohlarn is best for travellers who want a fresh, clean room with a pool at an attainable price on the island. If your picture of Koh Larn is sleeping in a tidy room, waking up for a dip in the pool, a light breakfast, then renting a scooter to bounce between Tawaen and Samae beaches — it fits nicely. But if you want a stay right on the sand, or a big resort with a full set of facilities, a beachfront property will suit you better.

On price, standard rooms start from approx. ฿2,200/night, while the Superior Sea View and Family Room climb to around ฿2,800–3,500 depending on the season. Weekends and long holidays push rates up and fill fast, since there are only 14 rooms. If you're going on a holiday weekend, book ahead and lock in a free-cancellation rate first.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Tiamo Kohlarn, Koh Larn

faq.q: Where is Tiamo Kohlarn on Koh Larn?
faq.a: It's at 210/27 Moo 7, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri · about 1 km from Tawaen Beach and roughly a 10-minute walk from Na Ban Pier · it isn't directly on the beach, so you'll walk or rent a scooter to reach the water · local shops and eateries are within walking distance.

faq.q: How much does Tiamo Kohlarn cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: From approx. ฿2,200/night for a Superior Queen Room · Studio, Superior Sea View and Family rooms run around ฿2,500–3,500 depending on the season · rates rise on weekends and long holidays and rooms sell out fast (only 14 rooms), so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Tiamo Kohlarn have a swimming pool?
faq.a: Yes, it has an outdoor swimming pool · that's a real highlight here, since only a few stays at this price on Koh Larn offer a pool · perfect for cooling off after a day at the beach.

faq.q: Is Tiamo Kohlarn a new hotel — are the rooms old?
faq.a: It's a new hotel, opened in 2024 and renovated again in 2025 · so the rooms are still fresh and clean, without the worn furniture found in many of the island's older guesthouses — something reviewers mention often.

faq.q: How do I get to Tiamo Kohlarn?
faq.a: Take the ferry from Bali Hai Pier in Pattaya to Na Ban Pier on Koh Larn (about 45 minutes) · from the pier it's roughly a 10-minute walk, or take a songthaew / motorbike taxi · on the island, renting a scooter (~300 THB/day) is the easiest way to tour the beaches.

faq.q: Who is Tiamo Kohlarn best for?
faq.a: Best for travellers who want a fresh, clean room with a pool at an attainable price, like a quiet, private feel, and are happy to dip in the pool then ride out to the beaches · less ideal if you need a step-onto-the-sand beachfront stay or a large resort with a full set of facilities.
